sanskrit_verse:
पञ्चदश्यां चतुर्दश्याम् अष्टम्यां राहुसूतके ।
ऋतुसंधिषु भुक्त्वा वा श्राद्धिकं प्रतिगृह्य च ॥
transliteration: pañcadaśyāṃ caturdaशyām aṣṭamyāṃ rāhusūtake / ṛtusaṃdhiṣu bhuktvā vā śrāddhikaṃ pratigṛhya ca //
sph_interpretive_translation: One who has consumed food or accepted offerings during new moon, full moon, eighth day, solar eclipse, menstrual transitions, or Śrāddha ceremonies shall undergo immediate consciousness restoration through non-nutritional purification.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority: The act of ingestion or acceptance invokes energetic alignment with ritual timelines.
Causation: Consumption during astro-liminal periods creates karmic entanglement requiring conscious realignment.
Capacity-based responsibility: The individual's awareness at time of consumption determines the nature of restorative protocol.
Restoration logic: Purification is executed through withdrawal from material consequence, not infliction of penalty.
Consciousness alignment: Reintegration occurs via direct cognition of temporal-spiritual boundaries.
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Adjudication, this verse establishes that ritual-timed ingestion necessitates judicial activation of consciousness-based cleansing rather than punitive restriction. Responsibility thresholds are determined by the agent's recognition of liminal timing, not intent to transgress.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa confirms causal linkage between temporal ingestion and energetic misalignment. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests as sequential purification without suffering. Proportionality lies in restoring original spiritual clarity, not assigning fault. Non-punitive reality rule asserts that contamination is dissolved through cognitive reorientation alone.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate fasting until natural pranic equilibrium is restored
Perform mantra-based reversal of temporal ingestion effects
Undertake witness-consciousness meditation to disengage from karmic residue
Engage in ritual re-offering of consumed substances symbolically back to cosmic order
final_declaration: By the Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, ingestion within sacred-transitional moments demands purification through consciousness restoration. There is no punishment—only realignment. Dharma stands restored. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness is the Supreme Adjudicator.
